description: This source file exports functions and constants related to plugin SDK entry points, including building source paths, specifiers, package exports, and listing distribution artifacts. It leverages external JSON data for entry points.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkEntrySources
methods.description: Builds an object mapping each plugin SDK entry point to its source file path.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkSpecifiers
methods.description: Creates an array of module specifiers for plugin SDK entry points, with 'index' mapped specially.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkPackageExports
methods.description: Generates an object mapping entry points to their corresponding type and JavaScript distribution files, for package exports.

methods.name: listPluginSdkDistArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of distribution artifact file paths (.js and .d.ts) for all plugin SDK entry points.
